title: 盈利增速25%：市场还能涨？，他为何如此笃定
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: AI demand looks real to us, but it's skyrocketing growth will decelerate eventually when it does.
segments.zh: AI需求在我们看来是真实的，但其飞速增长最终会放缓，届时市场参与者可能不再将AI视为单一交易。

segments.en: Investors will likely stop pricing AI as one trade.
segments.zh: 市场参与者可能不再将AI视为单一交易。

segments.en: Ed, I am so glad to say joins us this morning. Ed, great to see you.
segments.zh: Ed，很高兴今早能邀请到您。Ed，见到您真好。

segments.en: So let's start there. This is something that we were struggling with a little bit with Nikolai Tengen in the last hour where on one hand, he's bullish AI and seeing a lot of productivity gains.
segments.zh: 我们从前一小时与Nikolai Tengen的讨论中遇到一些困惑：一方面他看好AI，看到许多生产力提升；另一方面他认为市场回报已到最佳。

segments.en: On the other hand, he's saying this is as good as it gets when it comes to market returns.
segments.zh: 另一方面，他认为市场回报已到最佳。

segments.en: Do you feel the same way? No, I think the market's going higher and I think it's going higher on earnings.
segments.zh: 您是否持相同看法？不，我认为市场会走高，且受盈利推动。

segments.en: As a matter of fact, I felt the need to coin a new acronym, which is female, fabulous earnings momentum.
segments.zh: 事实上，我觉得有必要创造一个新缩写：FEMALE，即“极佳盈利动能”。

segments.en: We all know about FOMO, which is kind of, it's nice while it works.
segments.zh: 我们都知道FOMO，它在有效时是好的。

segments.en: FOMO is fear of missing out. We saw that in the 1999 melt-up situation.
segments.zh: FOMO是“害怕错过”，我们在1999年的市场飙升中见过。

segments.en: Don't bother me with earnings. I just have to be in this internet concept.
segments.zh: 别拿盈利来烦我，我只要参与互联网概念。

segments.en: And this time around, the evaluation multiples kind of stuck around 20.
segments.zh: 而这一次，估值倍数大致维持在20倍左右。

segments.en: That's not low, but it's not terribly high, as long as the economy's growing.
segments.zh: 这个水平不算低，但也不算特别高，只要经济在增长。

segments.en: But it's earnings that have really been phenomenal. And some of that has been marked a market capital gains in SpaceX for Alphabet and Amazon.
segments.zh: 但真正令人惊叹的是盈利表现。其中一部分来自Alphabet和亚马逊在SpaceX的资本利得。

segments.en: But take that out and you basically have 25% increase in earnings in the second quarter and about the same in the third and fourth quarters.
segments.zh: 但剔除这部分，第二季度盈利增长约25%，第三和第四季度也大致相同。

segments.en: So yeah, I've been bullish on earnings with that bullish enough.
segments.zh: 所以，我对盈利一直持乐观态度，但还不够乐观。
